youtube_description: ANC Youth League leader Julius Malema is interviewed live on air from the floor of the IEC's 2011 local elections results centre in Pretoria, by 702's Mandy Wiener. Moments before he had held an impromptu press conference, declaring that he won't debate the DA's Lindi Mazibuko because she is merely "the madam's [Helen Zille] teagirl"; that followed on eTV bumping Mazibuko from a show to accommodate Malema -- and his wish to not debate her.
